# Quaver Desk

> Quaver Desk is a self-hosted business phone system (PBX) for small teams of 2 to 100 people, made in the UK. It is a web app with its own FreeSWITCH voice server, runs on one Linux server or VM (Debian 12 or Ubuntu 24.04), and works with any SIP trunk (Twilio, Gamma, BT, Simwood, Voiceflex and others). There are no per-minute platform fees: calls are billed by the SIP trunk provider. It is source-available under the Elastic License 2.0.

Key facts:

- Free plan: up to 3 users, 1 number, 1 SIP trunk, no licence key and no time limit.
- Paid plans are priced per site by team size, not per seat. No VAT is added.
  - Plus: £15/month (up to 5 users), £29 (6–10), £49 (11–25), £89 (26–50), £149 (51–100).
  - Pro: £29/month (up to 5 users), £55 (6–10), £99 (11–25), £179 (26–50), £299 (51–100).
  - Yearly billing: 12 months for the price of 10. Over 100 users: quote.
- Hosted option: from £49/month (Plus) or £69/month (Pro) for up to 5 people, 2 numbers and 1,000 UK call minutes a month, hosted on UK servers.
- Features: phone in the browser, SIP desk phones (Yealink, Poly, Grandstream), opening hours, ring groups, IVR menus, follow-me to mobiles with call acceptance, transfer, hold, call park, voicemail to email, call recording with announcement, AI transcripts and summaries using the customer's own AI provider account, two-factor sign-in, passkeys, toll-fraud limits, 999 calls never blocked.
